easyPrerequisites: Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
description:
Cast Whirlwind Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Lutri by paying its mana cost reduced by Ballad of the Black Flag.
When Lutri enters, it triggers, copying Whirlwind Technique targeting Lutri.
Resolve Whirlwind Technique, airbending Lutri.
Holding priority, cast Lutri from exile by paying {0} due to Ballad of the Black Flag.
Repeat from step 3.
